DECOLONIZING THE STATE BUDGET
30,000
GOVERNMENT
EMPLOYEES.
7 MILLION
PEASANTS.
THE IMBALANCE
Out of a 58 billion CFA franc
budget, 30 billion went to just
30,000 state officials, leaving
almost nothing for the 7 million
rural citizens.
THE SOLUTION
- Slashed salaries of all state officials,
including the President.
- Banned first-class travel; ministers
restricted to meager daily allowances.
- Rejected structural adiustment loans
from foreign powers.
THE IMPACT
Erased a 695 million CFA franc
deficit in one year, turning it into
a 1 billion CFA franc surplus for
public investment.

NEO-COLONIAL AID
- Creates a welfare mentality.
- Imposes foreign structures (NGOs
acting as spy agencies or political
fiefdoms).

TRUE SOLIDARITY
- Strengthens national sovereignty.
- Based on mutual respect and
shared struggles.
- Empowers local production and
self-sufficiency.
Aid must go in the direction of destroying aid.
All aid that kills aid is welcome in Burkina Faso.
